QuestInfo.name: Claudine's Friend
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2151002##k, the Wild Hunter trainer, wants to see you.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2151002# says #p2151003# looks a little sad these days.

Find the #b#t4033636##k in #b#m931060000##k for #bBelle#k. #b#m931060000##k is accessible through the #bblue door#k to the right of the giant Edelstein mansion.
QuestInfo.2: The photo from #b#m931060000##k shows two children in old Edelstein smiling. Looking at the photo makes your heart ache. When you took the #b#t4033636##k to #p2151002#, she got a little misty-eyed.

0.0: Hey #b#h0##k. The others told me you're all right. Guess you won't mind if I ask you some questions.
0.1: I heard you saved #p2151003#, right? That's what got you a free pass into our HQ.
0.2: But here's what confuses me: I've NEVER seen old Cold-Shoulder #p2151003# act so emotional. She's also been staring at knives all day, which is super creepy when I'm microwaving popcorn.
0.3: That's why I want you to #bget something#k for me. Well?

yes.0: I want you to go to the #b#m931060000##k, over by the giant mansion at the center of Edelstein. No one lives there now, but it used to be my friend's place. They left this\r\n#b#t4033636##k over there, and I want it back.

no.0: You're just going to turn me down? I thought you were in love with #p2151003#.

1.0: That photo bring back any memories?\r\n#L0##b(You tell her what you felt.)#l\n#k

yes.0: That doesn't make sense though... Edelstein was at peace back then. The Black Wings weren't even around when...

item.0: You don't know where #b#m931060000##k is? Exit here and go to the mansion with the giant clock. You'll see the #bblue front door#k to the right. Bring back that  #b#t4033636##k.
